title: A genome-wide CRISPR base-editing resource for functional genomics and drug-response mapping in Leishmania mexicana
authors: Arias del Angel J; Link F; May NH; Ekici I; Wawra K; Schwind S; Zorn S; Haggarty J; Weidt SK; Ritchie R; Barrett MP; van Zandbergen G; Beneke T
one_liner_zh: 该文利用CRISPR碱基编辑文库在利什曼原虫中进行全基因组功能筛选和药物反应作图，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作、结合位点预测或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract:
ABSTRACT

We present a CRISPR/Cas9 cytosine base editing library for genome-wide loss-of-function screening in L. mexicana and apply it to dissect the genetics of Leishmania drug response. The results, accessible at https://www.LeishBASEeditDB.net , revealed novel response biomarkers for Sb III , miltefosine, amphotericin B, pentamidine, and the arylmethylaminosteroid 1c. We identified hundreds of loci linked to altered drug responses, including opposing effects among paralogs, cross-resistance, and collateral sensitivity. Among 41 validated candidates, we identified sterol defects in two novel amphotericin B markers, discovered a regulator of intracellular miltefosine transporter complex localization, and uncovered evidence that flagellar-associated defects reduce drug sensitivity. Parallel viability and motility screens revealed, for the first time, genome-wide fitness contributions of unique and multi-copy genes in Leishmania promastigotes. Our approach enables powerful reverse genetic screens across Leishmania species, advancing drug mechanism studies and guiding combination therapy designs. The library is available for others to screen a multitude of additional loss-of-function phenotypes.
abstract_zh: 我们展示了一个用于墨西哥利什曼原虫全基因组功能缺失筛选的CRISPR/Cas9胞嘧啶碱基编辑文库，并将其应用于解析利什曼原虫药物反应的遗传学基础。结果可在https://www.LeishBASEeditDB.net 获取，揭示了针对三价锑（Sb III ）、米替福新、两性霉素B、喷他脒以及芳基甲基氨基甾体1c的新型反应生物标志物。我们鉴定了数百个与药物反应改变相关的基因位点，包括旁系同源基因间的相反效应、交叉耐药性和交叉敏感性。在41个验证的候选基因中，我们识别出两个新型两性霉素B标志物中的甾醇缺陷，发现了一个调控细胞内米替福新转运体复合物定位的因子，并获得了鞭毛相关缺陷降低药物敏感性的证据。平行的活力与运动性筛选首次揭示了利什曼原虫前鞭毛体中独特基因和多拷贝基因的全基因组适应性贡献。我们的方法能够在利什曼原虫物种间进行强大的反向遗传筛选，推进药物机制研究并指导联合治疗方案设计。该文库可供他人筛选多种额外的功能缺失表型。
